wounds.jaymospowers.part.head: Head
commands.jaymospowers.wounds.unknown_par: That creature has no such part
message.jaymospowers.downed.down: You're down. Crawl to safety, or wait for someone to bring you round.
message.jaymospowers.downed.give_up: You're down. Hold sneak to give up [%s]
message.jaymospowers.downed.give_up_hurt: %s too hurt to get up. Hold sneak to give up [%s]
message.jaymospowers.downed.give_up_out: You've passed out. Hold sneak to give up [%s]
message.jaymospowers.downed.rise_hint: You're down. Hold sneak to get yourself up
message.jaymospowers.downed.rise_knocked: Knocked back down! Let go of sneak and try again
message.jaymospowers.downed.risen: You drag yourself to your feet.
message.jaymospowers.downed.self_revive_: A blow knocks the food from your mouth.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.battered: You're up, but battered: you won't heal past this till you've slept it off.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.battered_sle: A night's rest: you've shaken off the battering.
message.jaymospowers.downed.no_food: You've nothing to eat to bring %s round with.
message.jaymospowers.downed.no_treat: You've nothing %s would take to bring them round.
message.jaymospowers.downed.held_down: %s won't get up while someone's Will holds them down.
message.jaymospowers.downed.revived: %s is back on their feet (your %s went to them).
message.jaymospowers.wounds.broken: %s broken: it won't heal right until it's set
message.jaymospowers.wounds.armless: Both arms broken: your hands can't hit or dig. Splint one to use it again.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.sprained: %s sprained: it'll mend as you heal
message.jaymospowers.wounds.set: Your broken bones are set: they can heal now
message.jaymospowers.wounds.knit: A broken bone or sprain has healed
tooltip.jaymospowers.linen_bandage: Binds a cut and heals the part. On yourself, use: pick a part. On another, hold use: the worst; tap: pick a part.
tooltip.jaymospowers.rag: A poor bandage, and dirty: the wound may fester. Hold use in water to wash it, or boil it in a cauldron over a fire.
tooltip.jaymospowers.splint: Sets a broken arm or leg and eases it while it knits.
tooltip.jaymospowers.needle_and_thread: Stitches a bleeding cut shut. It stings.
tooltip.jaymospowers.smelling_salts: Under the nose of one who's down: up on the spot.
tooltip.jaymospowers.leeches: A little blood for a long while without pain.
tooltip.jaymospowers.poppy_syrup: Dwale: strong against pain. Never two at once.
death.attack.jaymospowers.bleeding.playe: %1$s bled to death from wounds dealt by %2$s
message.jaymospowers.wounds.bleeding: %s bleeding: bind it, or stitch it
message.jaymospowers.wounds.festering: %s festering: pour spirits or honey on it, or drink a Potion of Cleansing
message.jaymospowers.wounds.rotted: %s rotted past saving, and is gone
message.jaymospowers.wounds.tea: The bitter tea goes down. The pain will ease soon.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.poppy: A warm haze settles over everything.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.craving: Your hands shake. You need the poppy.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.treated_by: %s is treating you with %s. Hold still.
message.jaymospowers.downed.self_revived: Second Wind! You find the strength to get up.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.leeches_bad_: The leeches draw the bad blood out of %s: plague and poison.
message.jaymospowers.downed.come_round: You come round. Crawl, or wait for help.
message.jaymospowers.downed.roused: The salts sting you awake. You're up!
message.jaymospowers.downed.knocked_out: Too much poppy: you're out cold.
message.jaymospowers.downed.knocked_rock: A rock out of nowhere: you're out cold.
message.jaymospowers.downed.knocked_mash: Out cold. Mash sneak to come round [%s]
item.jaymospowers.healers_satchel.hint: Right click with medicine to put it in, empty-handed to take it out
tooltip.jaymospowers.comfrey: Knitbone. Right click a grown plant to pick it; plant it on grass or dirt to grow more.
tooltip.jaymospowers.yarrow: Stops bleeding. Right click a grown plant to pick it; plant it to grow more.
tooltip.jaymospowers.plantain: Soothes burns. Right click a grown plant to pick it; plant it to grow more.
tooltip.jaymospowers.wild_garlic: Cleans wounds. Right click a grown plant to pick it; plant it to grow more.
tooltip.jaymospowers.chamomile: Calms. Right click a grown plant to pick it; plant it to grow more.
tooltip.jaymospowers.yarrow_powder: Packed into a cut, stops the bleeding at once. Not a stump.
tooltip.jaymospowers.knitbone_poultice: On a broken limb: the bone knits faster for ten minutes. Best over a splint.
tooltip.jaymospowers.burn_salve: Puts out fire, eases frost, and heals the part over time.
tooltip.jaymospowers.garlic_poultice: Cleans a wound, and it can't fester for ten minutes.
tooltip.jaymospowers.clean_rag: A washed or boiled rag: dresses like a rag, but never festers.
tooltip.jaymospowers.healers_satchel: Holds medicine. Carried, treatments take a quarter less time, and the next stack comes out when yours runs out.
tooltip.jaymospowers.bone_broth: Heals the worst parts a little, and cools a festering fever for a while.
tooltip.jaymospowers.chamomile_tea: Eases pain a little. Your next sleep heals every part twice over.
tooltip.jaymospowers.posset: Cures nausea and poison, and heals a little.
message.jaymospowers.wounds.treated.knit: %s poulticed: the bone will knit faster
message.jaymospowers.wounds.treated.garl: %s cleaned with garlic: it can't fester for a while
message.jaymospowers.wounds.boiling: %s rags in the pot: they will take a while
message.jaymospowers.wounds.boil_busy: The pot is already full of rags
message.jaymospowers.wounds.boil_cold: The water needs a fire under the cauldron
message.jaymospowers.wounds.calm_sleep: A calm sleep: your wounds mend
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.herb.1: Grows wild; right click a grown plant to pick 1-3
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.herb.2: Plant the herb on grass, dirt or farmland
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.yarrow.1: Stops a cut's bleeding at once
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.yarrow.2: Not a stump: that wants cautery
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.knitbone.1: Heals %s now, then the bone knits faster for %s min
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.knitbone.2: A broken arm, leg, foot or wing; best over a splint
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.clean_rag.1: Stops a cut, and never festers
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.clean_rag.2: Heals %s; washed or boiled from a rag
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.satchel.3: Refills the stack in hand when it runs out
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.chamomile.1: Next sleep heals every part x%s
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.wash.1: Hold use in or facing water: a rag every %s s
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.boil.1: Use rags on a water cauldron over a fire: %s per level
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.boil.2: A batch takes %s s, always clean
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.boil.3: Fire, soul fire, campfire, magma or lava below
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.use_part: Hold use on another; tap: pick the part
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.rag.1: Stops a cut, but it's dirty
jei.jaymospowers.medicine.splint.1: Sets a broken arm or leg
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.body_sub: Pick a part. Hold still while it's done.
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.help: Hover a part to see its state; parts your medicine can't help are greyed.
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.look_sub: Hold a bandage, splint or the like to treat from here.
screen.jaymospowers.wounds.look_help: Hover a part to see how whole it is, and whether it's broken, bleeding or festering.
message.jaymospowers.limbs.gone: %s gone: you can't do that without it
message.jaymospowers.limbs.no_arms: No arms left to do that with
